qualification_limits: Manifest grant facts came from assigned TSV; canonical PG16 must recheck current pg_proc grants and function definitions.
Literal proof covers representative inputs, null/error boundaries, not exhaustive strings/branches.
Identity proof is proposed SQL, not yet executed. No broad tenant matrix acceptance.
fn_guest_org_id is a public selector, not authorization; token/review fallback and inactive/expired cases remain uncovered here.
Identity tests omit session revocation, inactive profiles, sensitive_grants toggles, legacy role override denial and owner-only full-role limit contrasts.
fn_is_staff checks active profile but unlike staff_id/current_role/org_id does not call fn_session_ok; source semantic difference, no authorization fix proposed.
Pure data-independent functions get proposed tenant-target/CRUD N_A only; their executable API and literal response contracts remain explicit.
